question: Which V17 direction best closes verified effect outcome -> causally valid provenance re-entry -> terminal DONE without weakening self.root execution fencing?

baseline_negative_evidence.finding: V14 accepts empty/unbound reentry, trace OK, REENTERED treated as COMPLETE, no explicit DONE.
Target-VPS negative evidence persisted for early V17 schema binding gap before storage guards.

strengths: exact V14 effect/attempt/verified-outcome binding after later storage guards
legacy arbitrary-dict reentry disabled on guarded public candidate surface
separate REENTERED then DONE recovery surface
fatal_or_material_gaps: candidate stores episode/signal/causal/delta identifiers as text and does not require actual current V15/V16 execution ownership
fabricated support identifiers can therefore satisfy its self-verifier and reach DONE in the pre-fix candidate
two-phase REENTERED -> DONE introduces a durable intermediate crash window that must be justified rather than assumed useful

strengths: effect bound while RESERVED to exact execution_id + V15 lease_epoch
requires current V15 BUSY/RECOVERING and matching V16 RUNNING execution plus EXECUTION_BOUND event
requires actual attention episode + receiver used=1 + local_effect=1
requires actual causal-credit and CURRENT semantic-record identities
REENTRY + terminal DONE can be committed atomically in one transaction
legacy REENTERED update fails closed unless matching binding + terminal DONE already exist

newly_falsified_gap.finding: Existing foreign keys prove referenced rows exist but do not prove they form the same causal chain. An unrelated UNVERIFIED prediction outcome can supply causal credit if target_key names the effect; an unrelated CURRENT semantic record can be spliced in; support_snapshot_hash is free text. The candidate can still reach effective DONE.

candidates.why_selected_basis: It dominates the text-only candidate on execution fencing, canonical GWT use and transactional terminalization, but current relational closure is insufficient for promotion.

required_fusion_before_promotion: Introduce an explicit verified-effect-outcome -> causal-credit receipt binding, not merely target_key=effect_id.
Require the causal-credit source outcome to be verified and structurally linked to the same effect/GWT causal episode.
Introduce an explicit causal-credit -> admitted semantic delta admission receipt, or an equally strong typed relation.
Replace free support_snapshot_hash authority with a receipt/FK-backed support snapshot identity or remove it from authority-bearing checks.
Preserve an explicit typed no-learning terminal path without fabricating a semantic delta.
Keep execution_id + lease_epoch fencing and same-transaction terminal DONE.
Run target-VPS negative cross-splice tests, valid-chain tests, transaction abort, hard process/power cutpoints, stale epoch, concurrency, rollback and resource shadows before canonical migration.

additional_test_committed_this_run.purpose: Read-only full-causal/atomic schema discriminator against current V15/V16/GWT/causal/semantic tables.
